headline: Strong execution, expanding offerings, higher recurring mix to drive multiple expansion

highlights: Apart from structural tailwinds, traction in asset and wealth management, as well as distribution, led to operating PAT (ex- treasury) rising to more than INR 7.5bn in Q2FY27 from INR 3.8bn in Q2FY24.
Over the years, it has successfully transitioned from a transaction-heavy business model to a more sustainable recurring revenue model.
This is evident from the share of recurring revenue rising to ~66% in Q2FY27 from 55% in FY24.

The strong execution in Q2FY27 is illustrated by 1) MF with alternates/PE/RE ending AUM growing ~26% YoY; 2) Private Wealth Management (PWM) recurring AUM growing ~31% YoY, and (3) loan book in WM (Broking) increasing 42% YoY.
valuation: Based on our valuation multiples, holding company discount, and distributed business model, we believe the risk-reward ratio continues to be favourable.

Our revised TP of INR 1,326 (earlier INR 1,024) is based on FY28E SoTP-based P/E multiples of 15x/30x/27x/15x for the capital markets business (IB+IE)/(AMC+PE)/PWM/WM (broking), and a multiple of 1.2x FY28E book value for the HFC segment.
We have raised the AMC/PWM multiples from 25x each to 30x/27x, respectively, reflecting strong execution and optionalities ahead.
watch: Based on our valuation multiples, holding company discount, and distributed business model, we believe the risk-reward ratio continues to be favourable.
Risks: A broader market downturn and deterioration in MF performance.
